_comment: Import into Pterodactyl 1.x after replacing the image placeholder with your published combined image.
name: Bomber Pengu - Web + Relay
author: deploy@example.org
description: Browser game and relay in one image. Publish your Dockerfile build and replace ghcr.io/OWNER/REPO-server:latest. Uses the primary allocation for HTTP and /ws. Put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front for public play. No files need installing in /home/container.
